reason: positive side failed on lockfile_conflict seed 5: guard refused git config override: git config override 'core.quotePath=false'; only ['protocol.file.allow=always'] may be set per invocation

refused_program.intent: Catch up with upstream by merging it into the current branch, resolving each conflicted file by starting from upstream's version of that file and adding back the lines the local side added, so nothing added on either side is lost and nothing either side removed is revived.

preconditions.name: upstream_ref_present

preconditions.name: local_has_own_commits

preconditions.description: upstream has at least one commit that HEAD does not have

preconditions.description: at least one path changed on both sides since the merge base
preconditions.name: both_sides_touched_the_same_file
preconditions.probe:
mb=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}) &&
comm -12 \
  <(git -c core.quotePath=false diff --name-only -z "$mb" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git -c core.quotePath=false diff --name-only -z "$mb" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  | grep -q .

preconditions.description: the worktree is clean, or a merge is already in progress
preconditions.name: worktree_ready_for_merge
